brief:
Palestinian Authority security forces have held engineer Alaa al-Araj from Nablus for a ninth consecutive day, Shehab Wire reported. His detention has been extended for an additional 15 days as the security apparatus continues to hold him in custody without public disclosure of charges or legal grounds for the arrest.

The detention marks a significant development in al-Araj's legal situation. He was released from Israeli custody less than a year ago, only to face arrest by Palestinian Authority security forces. The circumstances surrounding his latest arrest remain unclear, with no official statement issued regarding the reasons for or duration of his confinement beyond the newly extended 15-day period.
